newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: More Zairean refugees cross border into Zambia.
newsitem.headline: More Zairean refugees cross border into Zambia.

text.p: The Zambia Red Cross said on Tuesday another 700 Zaireans fleeing the civil war in eastern Zaire crossed the border into northern Zambia.
It said the refugees crossed over at Kaputa district.
"We have received information that some 700 refugees arrived in Kaputa this morning," Red Cross head of programmes Maimbolwa Muuba told Reuters.
The new arrivals bring to around 6,500 the number of Zaireans who have fled to Zambia since October 1996 when rebels in eastern Zaire started their campaign against the government
Last week up to 3,000 Zaireans travelling by boat crossed Lake Tanganyika into Zambia through Mpulungu district.
Muuba said about 240 of the new arrivals had asked to be transferred to the border town of Chililabombwe so they could travel to safe areas in Zaire.
"They do not want to stay here. Their only request is that they be granted safe passage through the Kasumbalesa border post to safe areas in Zaire," she said.
The United Nations High Commission for Refugees (UNHCR) said on Tuesday 22 refugees had died in the past few days from various causes while trying to cross the border.
